messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sometimes it is not safe to use certain medications at the same time. Some drugs can affect your blood levels of other drugs you take, which may increase side effects or make the medications less effective.
Ask your doctor before taking a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) such as aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, Advil, Aleve, Motrin, and others. Using an NSAID with duloxetine may cause you to bruise or bleed easily.
Many drugs can interact with duloxetine. This includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products. Not all possible interactions are listed here. Tell your doctor about all other medicines you use.
Triplet: ["Duloxetine", "has interaction warning", "not all interactions are listed"]

The relation 'has interaction warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a warning that not all possible interactions with other substances are listed.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has off label use': The subject drug may be used for medical conditions or purposes not specifically listed in official guidelines or labeling.
B. 'has incomplete interaction list': The list of potential interactions for the subject drug is not exhaustive and may miss other drugs, including prescription, over-the-counter, vitamins, and herbal products.
C. 'has unknown risk duration': The risk associated with the subject drug is not known to continue beyond the specified duration of treatment.
D. 'has unclear mechanism of action': The exact way the subject drug exerts its effect on the specified condition is not fully understood.
E. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
